<!--
  PDF: this report is HTML-first because its cards/chips/scales/tabsets are raw
  HTML styled by vipspace_report_style.scss, which LaTeX would discard. The PDF
  is produced by *printing this HTML* (weasyprint or a browser), driven by
  generate_report.py. The .scss @media print block handles page breaks and
  expands tabsets so every panel appears on paper. When rendering for PDF the
  pipeline sets VIPSEGD_STATIC_CHARTS=1 so the interactive Plotly charts fall
  back to static images (weasyprint runs no JavaScript).
-->

```{python}
import warnings
import os
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import io, base64, html as _html, datetime, math, re
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from IPython.display import display, Markdown, HTML

# ── Paths: ViSpace output tree under out_dir/<slide_name>/ ─────────────────
root  = Path(out_dir) / slide_name
tess  = root / "tessellation"
seg   = root / "segmentation"
sf    = root / "spatial_feature_results"
tsr_d = sf / "cluster_tils_tsr_score"
imm_d = sf / "immune_proximity"
nec_d = sf / "necrosis_feature"
mor_d = sf / "tumor_morphology"
cache_d = root / "_report_image_cache"


def load_csv(path, **kw):
    p = Path(path)
    return pd.read_csv(p, **kw) if p.exists() else pd.DataFrame()

manifest    = load_csv(seg / "manifest.csv")

# TSR/TIL stage: the legacy filenames remain the stable report contract.
# Each row in tils_tsr_by_cluster.csv now represents one Master ROI
# (region_id identifies the Master ROI).
tsr_cluster = load_csv(tsr_d / "tils_tsr_by_cluster.csv")
tsr_summary = load_csv(tsr_d / "tils_tsr_wsi_summary.csv")

imm_cluster = load_csv(imm_d / "immune_proximity_by_cluster.csv")
imm_summary = load_csv(imm_d / "immune_proximity_wsi_summary.csv")
nec_cluster = load_csv(nec_d / "necrosis_feature_by_cluster.csv")
nec_summary = load_csv(nec_d / "necrosis_feature_wsi_summary.csv")
mor_cluster = load_csv(mor_d / "tumor_core_features_by_cluster.csv")
mor_summary = load_csv(mor_d / "tumor_core_wsi_summary.csv")

CLASS_COLORS = {
    "Tumor":        "#e31a1c",
    "Stroma":       "#33a02c",
    "Inflammatory": "#1f78b4",
    "Necrosis":     "#ff9f1c",
    "Others":       "#b54cc8",
}

# ── Formatting helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def _num(v):
    try:
        if v is None:
            return None
        f = float(v)
        return f if np.isfinite(f) else None
    except Exception:
        return None


def first_value(row, cols):
    if row is None:
        return None, None
    if isinstance(cols, str):
        cols = [cols]
    for col in cols:
        try:
            if col in row.index:
                v = row.get(col)
                if not (pd.isna(v) if not isinstance(v, (list, tuple, dict)) else False):
                    return v, col
        except Exception:
            pass
    return None, None


def fmt_num(v, decimals=2, suffix=""):
    n = _num(v)
    return "—" if n is None else f"{n:.{decimals}f}{suffix}"


def fmt_int(v):
    n = _num(v)
    return "—" if n is None else f"{n:,.0f}"


def fmt_pct(v, decimals=1):
    n = _num(v)
    return "—" if n is None else f"{n:.{decimals}f}%"


def fmt_frac_pct(v, decimals=1):
    n = _num(v)
    return "—" if n is None else f"{100*n:.{decimals}f}%"


def fmt_str(v):
    if v is None:
        return "—"
    try:
        if pd.isna(v):
            return "—"
    except Exception:
        pass
    return _html.escape(str(v))


def badge(text, color):
    return f'<span class="badge" style="background:{color}">{_html.escape(str(text))}</span>'


def phenotype_color(ph):
    ph = str(ph).lower()
    palette = {
        # immune phenotypes
        "penetrated": "#68e08b", "peritumoral": "#69c2ff", "margin": "#ffd166",
        "excluded": "#ff8d6e", "desert": "#b4bdc8",
        # necrosis phenotypes (3-tier: absent / focal / present)
        "absent":  "#aab5c2",
        "focal":   "#ffbf69",
        "present": "#ff6b7a",
        # fallback
        "indeterminate": "#c5d0dd",
    }
    for k, c in palette.items():
        if k in ph:
            return c
    return "#9fb4ca"


def section_intro(kicker, title, text=""):
    copy = f'<div class="section-copy">{_html.escape(text)}</div>' if text else ""
    display(HTML(
        '<div class="section-hero">'
        f'<div class="section-kicker">{_html.escape(kicker)}</div>'
        f'<div class="section-title">{_html.escape(title)}</div>'
        f'{copy}'
        '</div>'
    ))


def metric_cards(pairs):
    """pairs: list of (title, value_html, subtitle)."""
    cells = "".join(
        f'<div class="vb"><div class="vb-t">{_html.escape(str(t))}</div>'
        f'<div class="vb-v">{v}</div><div class="vb-s">{_html.escape(str(s))}</div></div>'
        for t, v, s in pairs
    )
    display(HTML(f'<div class="vb-grid">{cells}</div>'))


def smart_cards(df, specs, fallback_max=8):
    if df is None or df.empty:
        display(Markdown("*No slide-level summary available.*"))
        return
    row = df.iloc[0]
    cards = []
    for cols, title, subtitle, kind in specs:
        raw, used = first_value(row, cols)
        if raw is None:
            continue
        if kind == "pct_frac":
            val = fmt_frac_pct(raw)
        elif kind == "pct":
            val = fmt_pct(raw)
        elif kind == "int":
            val = fmt_int(raw)
        elif kind == "mm2":
            val = f"{fmt_num(raw)} mm²"
        elif kind == "mm":
            val = f"{fmt_num(raw)} mm"
        elif kind == "um":
            val = f"{fmt_num(raw)} µm"
        elif kind == "per_mm":
            val = f"{fmt_num(raw)} mm⁻¹"
        elif kind == "density":
            val = f"{fmt_num(raw)}/mm²"
        elif kind == "str":
            val = fmt_str(raw)
        else:
            val = fmt_num(raw)
        cards.append((title, val, subtitle))
    if not cards:
        numeric_cols = []
        for col in df.columns:
            n = _num(row.get(col))
            if n is not None:
                label = col.replace("wsi_", "").replace("_", " ").capitalize()
                numeric_cols.append((label, fmt_num(n), col))
            if len(numeric_cols) >= fallback_max:
                break
        cards = numeric_cols
    metric_cards(cards)


def cluster_chips(df, fields, badge_field=None, badge_color_fn=None, max_cards=18, id_prefix="Cluster"):
    """fields: list of (col(s), label, kind). kind in num, int, pct, pct_frac, str, mm2, um, density."""
    if df is None or df.empty:
        display(Markdown("*No per-cluster data available.*"))
        return
    d = df.copy()
    # Feature tables use region_id; older outputs used cluster_id.
    id_col = "region_id" if "region_id" in d.columns else "cluster_id"
    if id_col in d.columns:
        d = d.sort_values(id_col)
    if len(d) > max_cards:
        # Keep report readable: show tumor/feature-rich clusters first when possible.
        priority_cols = ["tumor_area_mm2", "til_total_area_mm2", "necrosis_area_mm2",
                         "cluster_area_mm2", "region_area_mm2"]
        for c in priority_cols:
            if c in d.columns:
                d = d.sort_values(c, ascending=False)
                break
        d = d.head(max_cards)
    chips = []
    for _, r in d.iterrows():
        cid = int(r[id_col]) if id_col in d.columns and pd.notna(r.get(id_col)) else "—"
        lines = []
        for cols, label, kind in fields:
            raw, _ = first_value(r, cols)
            if kind == "pct":
                v = fmt_pct(raw)
            elif kind == "pct_frac":
                v = fmt_frac_pct(raw)
            elif kind == "int":
                v = fmt_int(raw)
            elif kind == "mm2":
                v = f"{fmt_num(raw)} mm²"
            elif kind == "mm":
                v = f"{fmt_num(raw)} mm"
            elif kind == "um":
                v = f"{fmt_num(raw)} µm"
            elif kind == "per_mm":
                v = f"{fmt_num(raw)} mm⁻¹"
            elif kind == "density":
                v = f"{fmt_num(raw)}/mm²"
            elif kind == "str":
                v = fmt_str(raw)
            else:
                v = fmt_num(raw)
            lines.append(f'<div class="chip-line"><span class="k">{_html.escape(label)}</span><span class="v">{v}</span></div>')
        badge_html = ""
        if badge_field and badge_field in d.columns:
            ph = r.get(badge_field, "—")
            color = badge_color_fn(str(ph)) if badge_color_fn else "#9fb4ca"
            badge_html = f'<div style="margin-top:8px">{badge(ph, color)}</div>'
        chips.append(f'<div class="chip"><span class="chip-id">{_html.escape(str(id_prefix))} {cid}</span>{"".join(lines)}{badge_html}</div>')
    extra = ""
    if len(df) > max_cards:
        extra = f'<div class="img-note">Showing {max_cards} of {len(df)} clusters to keep the page nimble.</div>'
    display(HTML(f'<div class="chip-row">{"".join(chips)}</div>{extra}'))


# ── Robust image compression + embed ────────────────────────────────────────
def compress_image_for_report(path, max_width=1600, max_bytes=2_200_000, quality=82, cache_dir=None, prefer_jpeg=True):
    """Create a display-sized compressed copy, then return (compressed_path, original_size, compressed_size)."""
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.exists():
        return None, None, None
    try:
        from PIL import Image
        Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
        cache_dir = Path(cache_dir or cache_d)
        cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        stem = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", "_", p.stem)
        out = cache_dir / f"{stem}_w{max_width}.jpg"
        if out.exists() and out.stat().st_mtime >= p.stat().st_mtime and out.stat().st_size <= max_bytes:
            return out, p.stat().st_size, out.stat().st_size
        img = Image.open(p)
        if img.mode not in ("RGB", "L"):
            img = img.convert("RGB")
        w, h = img.size
        if w > max_width:
            try:
                resample = Image.Resampling.LANCZOS
            except Exception:
                resample = Image.LANCZOS
            img = img.resize((max_width, max(1, round(h * max_width / w))), resample)
        q = int(quality)
        # Save progressively smaller JPEGs until the payload is browser-friendly.
        while True:
            img.convert("RGB").save(out, format="JPEG", quality=q, optimize=True, progressive=True)
            if out.stat().st_size <= max_bytes or q <= 55:
                break
            q -= 7
        return out, p.stat().st_size, out.stat().st_size
    except Exception:
        return p, p.stat().st_size if p.exists() else None, p.stat().st_size if p.exists() else None


def show_image(path, max_width=1600, missing_msg=None, note=None, max_bytes=2_200_000):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.exists():
        hint = ""
        try:
            sibs = sorted(q.name for q in p.parent.glob("*") if q.is_file())
            if sibs:
                hint = " &nbsp;Folder contains: " + ", ".join(f"`{s}`" for s in sibs[:12])
        except Exception:
            pass
        display(Markdown(f"*{missing_msg or f'not available: `{p.name}`.'}*{hint}"))
        return
    out, orig_n, comp_n = compress_image_for_report(p, max_width=max_width, max_bytes=max_bytes)
    try:
        data = Path(out).read_bytes()
        mime = "jpeg" if str(out).lower().endswith((".jpg", ".jpeg")) else "png"
        uri = "data:image/" + mime + ";base64," + base64.b64encode(data).decode()
        size_note = ""
        if orig_n and comp_n and orig_n > comp_n:
            size_note = f"Compressed for report display: {orig_n/1e6:.1f} MB → {comp_n/1e6:.1f} MB."
        if note:
            size_note = f"{note} {size_note}".strip()
        note_html = ""
        if size_note:
            note_html = '<div class="img-note">' + _html.escape(size_note) + '</div>'
        display(HTML(
            f'<div class="report-img-wrap"><img src="{uri}" class="report-img">'
            + note_html
            + '</div>'
        ))
    except Exception:
        display(Markdown(f'<img src="{p.resolve().as_posix()}" style="max-width:100%;">'))


# ── Scale reference renderers ───────────────────────────────────────────────
def scale_value(row, cols):
    raw, _ = first_value(row, cols)
    return _num(raw)


def format_scale_value(v, kind):
    if v is None:
        return "—"
    if kind == "pct_frac":
        return fmt_frac_pct(v)
    if kind == "pct":
        return fmt_pct(v)
    if kind == "int":
        return fmt_int(v)
    if kind == "um":
        return f"{fmt_num(v)} µm"
    if kind == "mm2":
        return f"{fmt_num(v)} mm²"
    if kind == "mm":
        return f"{fmt_num(v)} mm"
    if kind == "per_mm":
        return f"{fmt_num(v)} mm⁻¹"
    if kind == "density":
        return f"{fmt_num(v)}/mm²"
    return fmt_num(v)


def scales_html(row, scales):
    parts = []
    for s in scales:
        v = scale_value(row, s["cols"])
        lo, hi = float(s["lo"]), float(s["hi"])
        pct = 0.0 if v is None else max(0.0, min(1.0, (float(v) - lo) / (hi - lo))) * 100.0
        vtxt = format_scale_value(v, s.get("kind", "num"))
        parts.append(
            f'<div class="scale-row"><div class="scale-head">'
            f'<span class="scale-name">{_html.escape(s["label"])}</span>'
            f'<span class="scale-val">{vtxt}</span></div>'
            f'<div class="scale-track"><div class="scale-fill" style="width:{pct:.1f}%"></div>'
            f'<div class="scale-marker" style="left:{pct:.1f}%"></div></div>'
            f'<div class="scale-ends"><span>{_html.escape(s["low"])} ({format_scale_value(lo, s.get("kind", "num"))})</span>'
            f'<span>{_html.escape(s["high"])} ({format_scale_value(hi, s.get("kind", "num"))})</span></div>'
            f'<div class="scale-blurb">{_html.escape(s["meaning"])}</div></div>'
        )
    return '<div class="scale-wrap">' + "".join(parts) + '</div>'


def show_scales(df, scales, empty="No scale reference available because the slide-level summary is missing."):
    if df is None or df.empty:
        display(Markdown(f"*{empty}*"))
        return
    display(HTML(scales_html(df.iloc[0], scales)))


def reference_box(title, items):
    lis = "".join(f"<li>{item}</li>" for item in items)
    display(HTML(f'<div class="ref-box"><div class="ref-title">{_html.escape(title)}</div><ul class="ref-list">{lis}</ul></div>'))


def stil_level(value, reliable=True):
    """Descriptive computational sTIL band used by this report."""
    try:
        v = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return "unreliable"
    if not reliable or not np.isfinite(v):
        return "unreliable"
    if v < 5.0:
        return "very low"
    if v < 10.0:
        return "low"
    if v < 30.0:
        return "intermediate"
    return "high"


def tsr_pct_from_ratio(ratio):
    """(tumor %, stroma %) of the tumor + stroma compartment from tumor:stroma ratio."""
    r = _num(ratio)
    if r is None or r < 0:
        return None, None
    stroma = 100.0 / (1.0 + r)
    return 100.0 - stroma, stroma


def tsr_topology(cluster_df):
    """Slide-level Master-ROI counts/area, aggregated from the per-Master-ROI table."""
    out = {"n_master_rois": 0, "n_foci": None, "n_intertumor_edges": None,
           "total_master_area_mm2": None, "mean_master_tissue_fraction": None}
    if cluster_df is None or cluster_df.empty:
        return out
    d = cluster_df
    out["n_master_rois"] = int(d["region_id"].nunique()) if "region_id" in d.columns else int(len(d))
    for key, col, agg in [
        ("n_foci", "tumor_island_count", "sum"),
        ("n_intertumor_edges", "tumor_link_count", "sum"),
        ("total_master_area_mm2", "region_area_mm2", "sum"),
        ("mean_master_tissue_fraction", "tissue_coverage_fraction", "mean"),
    ]:
        if col in d.columns:
            out[key] = _num(pd.to_numeric(d[col], errors="coerce").agg(agg))
    return out

     "meaning":"Area-weighted major/minor axis ratio of tumor islands."},
    {"label":"Largest patch index",
     "cols":"tumor_largest_island_share",
     "lo":0, "hi":1, "low":"distributed", "high":"one island dominates",
     "kind":"num",
     "meaning":"Fraction of tumor area represented by the largest connected island."},
]


def morph_charts(df):
    """By-cluster tumor morphology charts with Plotly and static fallback."""
    if df is None or df.empty or "tumor_area_mm2" not in df.columns:
        return "<p><em>No tumor-positive clusters to chart.</em></p>"

    d = df[df["tumor_area_mm2"].fillna(0) > 0].copy().sort_values(
        "tumor_area_mm2", ascending=False
    )
    if d.empty:
        return "<p><em>No tumor-positive clusters to chart.</em></p>"

    d["lbl"] = "C" + d["region_id"].astype(int).astype(str)
    static_mode = str(os.environ.get("VIPSEGD_STATIC_CHARTS", "")).strip().lower() in (
        "1", "true", "yes", "on"
    )


    chart_specs = [
        ("tumor_area_mm2", "Area (mm²)", 1.0, None),
        ("tumor_boundary_length_mm", "Perimeter (mm)", 1.0, None),
        ("tumor_island_count", "Islands", 1.0, None),
        ("tumor_largest_island_share", "Largest island share", 1.0, [0, 1]),
    ]
    chart_specs = [x for x in chart_specs if x[0] in d.columns]

    if not static_mode:
        try:
            import plotly.graph_objects as go
            from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
            import plotly.io as pio

            fig = make_subplots(
                rows=1, cols=len(chart_specs), horizontal_spacing=0.06,
                subplot_titles=tuple(x[1] for x in chart_specs)
            )
            for i, (col, title, scale, rng) in enumerate(chart_specs, start=1):
                y = d[col].astype(float) * scale
                fig.add_bar(
                    x=d["lbl"], y=y, marker_color="#2f6db0",
                    row=1, col=i, showlegend=False,
                    hovertemplate="%{x}: %{y:.3g}<extra></extra>"
                )
                if rng:
                    fig.update_yaxes(range=rng, row=1, col=i)

            fig.update_layout(
                height=340, margin=dict(l=45, r=15, t=45, b=25),
                paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
                plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
                font=dict(size=12, color="#1f2733")
            )
            fig.update_xaxes(showgrid=False, color="#5b6678")
            fig.update_yaxes(gridcolor="rgba(31,39,51,0.12)", color="#5b6678")
            bars = pio.to_html(
                fig, include_plotlyjs=True, full_html=False,
                config={"displayModeBar": False}
            )

            bubble = ""
            if {"tumor_island_count", "tumor_largest_island_share"}.issubset(d.columns):
                sizes = d["tumor_area_mm2"].to_numpy(float)
                smax = max(sizes.max(), 1e-9)
                fig2 = go.Figure(go.Scatter(
                    x=d["tumor_island_count"],
                    y=d["tumor_largest_island_share"],
                    mode="markers+text",
                    text=d["lbl"],
                    textposition="middle center",
                    marker=dict(
                        size=22 + 62 * sizes / smax,
                        color="#2f6db0", opacity=0.62,
                        line=dict(color="#ffffff", width=1)
                    ),
                    hovertemplate="%{text}<br>islands=%{x}<br>LPI=%{y:.2f}<extra></extra>"
                ))
                fig2.update_layout(
                    height=345, margin=dict(l=55, r=15, t=15, b=45),
                    xaxis_title="Number of tumor islands",
                    yaxis_title="Largest island share",
                    paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
                    plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
                    font=dict(size=12, color="#1f2733")
                )
                fig2.update_yaxes(range=[0, 1])
                fig2.update_xaxes(gridcolor="rgba(31,39,51,0.12)", color="#5b6678")
                fig2.update_yaxes(gridcolor="rgba(31,39,51,0.12)", color="#5b6678")
                bubble = (
                    '<div class="chart-cap">Tumor island organization: '
                    'bubble size ∝ tumor area.</div>'
                    + '<div class="chart-block">'
                    + pio.to_html(fig2, include_plotlyjs=False, full_html=False,
                                  config={"displayModeBar": False})
                    + '</div>'
                )

            return f'<div class="chart-block">{bars}</div>{bubble}'
        except Exception:
            pass

    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use("Agg")
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    n = max(1, len(chart_specs))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, n, figsize=(3.4 * n, 3.1))
    if n == 1:
        axes = [axes]
    fig.patch.set_facecolor("#ffffff")

    for ax, (col, title, scale, rng) in zip(axes, chart_specs):
        ax.set_facecolor("#ffffff")
        y = d[col].astype(float) * scale
        ax.bar(d["lbl"], y, color="#2f6db0")
        ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, weight="bold", color="#1f2733")
        ax.tick_params(colors="#5b6678")
        ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
        ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=.2)
        if rng:
            ax.set_ylim(*rng)

    fig.tight_layout()
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format="png", dpi=140, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    uri = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
    return f'<div class="chart-block"><img src="{uri}" class="report-img" style="max-width:100%;"></div>'


report_date = datetime.date.today().strftime("%d %B %Y")
n_tiles     = len(manifest)
```

```{python}
# Conservative descriptive interpretation; not a diagnostic or prognostic class.
if not tsr_summary.empty:
    r = tsr_summary.iloc[0]

    stroma_pct = tsr_pct_from_ratio(r.get("tsr_tumor_to_stroma_ratio"))[1]
    stil = _num(r.get("til_stromal_pct"))
    itil = _num(r.get("til_intratumoral_pct"))
    inter_stil = _num(r.get("til_between_tumor_pct"))

    n_master = _num(tsr_topo["n_master_rois"])
    n_foci = _num(tsr_topo["n_foci"])
    n_edges = _num(tsr_topo["n_intertumor_edges"])

    sentences = []

    if stroma_pct is not None:
        if stroma_pct >= 50:
            sentences.append(
                f"The scored Master ROIs are stroma-dominant "
                f"({stroma_pct:.1f}% stroma within the tumor–stroma compartment)."
            )
        else:
            sentences.append(
                f"The scored Master ROIs are tumor-dominant "
                f"({stroma_pct:.1f}% stroma within the tumor–stroma compartment)."
            )

    if stil is not None and itil is not None:
        if stil > itil + 2:
            sentences.append(
                f"Inflammatory occupancy is greater in tumor-associated stroma "
                f"(sTIL {stil:.1f}%) than within the computational tumor bed "
                f"(iTIL {itil:.1f}%), indicating predominantly stromal immune localisation."
            )
        elif itil > stil + 2:
            sentences.append(
                f"Intratumoral inflammatory occupancy (iTIL {itil:.1f}%) exceeds "
                f"stromal inflammatory occupancy (sTIL {stil:.1f}%), indicating relatively "
                f"greater immune localisation within the reconstructed tumor compartment."
            )
        else:
            sentences.append(
                f"Stromal TIL ({stil:.1f}%) and intratumoral TIL ({itil:.1f}%) "
                f"are of similar magnitude."
            )

    if inter_stil is not None and n_edges is not None and n_edges > 0:
        if stil is not None:
            delta = inter_stil - stil
            if abs(delta) >= 2:
                direction = "higher" if delta > 0 else "lower"
                sentences.append(
                    f"Inter-tumor stromal TIL is {inter_stil:.1f}%, "
                    f"{abs(delta):.1f} percentage points {direction} than overall "
                    f"tumor-associated stromal TIL."
                )
            else:
                sentences.append(
                    f"Inter-tumor stromal TIL ({inter_stil:.1f}%) is similar to "
                    f"overall stromal inflammatory occupancy."
                )
        else:
            sentences.append(
                f"Inter-tumor stromal TIL is {inter_stil:.1f}% across validated corridors."
            )

    if n_master is not None and n_foci is not None:
        sentences.append(
            f"The analysis contains {int(n_foci)} retained tumor foci organized into "
            f"{int(n_master)} Master ROI(s)"
            + (
                f" with {int(n_edges)} accepted inter-tumor edge(s)."
                if n_edges is not None else "."
            )
        )

    if sentences:
        display(HTML(
            '<div class="ref-box">'
            '<div class="ref-title">Descriptive slide interpretation</div>'
            '<div class="section-copy">' +
            " ".join(_html.escape(s) for s in sentences) +
            '</div></div>'
        ))
```

```{python}
    (["til_outside_distance_median_um"], "Median extra distance", "area-weighted", "um"),
])
```

## Per cluster

```{python}
cluster_chips(
    imm_cluster,
    fields=[
        (["til_total_area_mm2"], "Inflammatory area", "mm2"),
        (["til_share_inside_tumor"], "Intratumoral", "pct_frac"),
        (["til_share_touching_tumor"], "Contact", "pct_frac"),
        (["til_within_50um_pct"], "Within 50 µm", "pct"),
        (["til_within_100um_pct"], "Within 100 µm", "pct"),
        (["til_within_200um_pct"], "Within 200 µm", "pct"),
        (["til_outside_distance_median_um"], "Extra distance", "um"),
    ],
    badge_field="immune_phenotype",
    badge_color_fn=phenotype_color,
)
```

## Scale reference

```{python}
show_scales(imm_summary, IMMUNE_SCALES)
reference_box("Immune phenotype rules used by the feature script", [
    "immune-desert: very low total TIL area, below the configured desert threshold.",
    "immune-penetrated: intratumoral TIL fraction is at least 0.30 by default.",
    "margin-localized: at least 50% of TIL area lies within 50 µm of the tumor boundary by default.",
    "immune-excluded: extratumoral median distance is at least 100 µm by default.",
    "peritumoral: extratumoral median distance is below 100 µm when other rules do not dominate."
])
```
